2800.translation: I oppose this plan because cost too high well-well.

2801.translation: Na like this small actions dey join bring big change.

2802.translation: Taste good; na only say portion small small.

2803.translation: The process hard, but anyway, I happy say result good.

2804.translation: The more I study, the more I realise how much I no know.

2805.translation: To summarise, this policy main aim no be cost cutting; na stronger safety.

2806.translation: Without enough evidence, claim say method work no dey convince well.

2807.translation: Because individual effort alone no fit easily solve this problem, support from institutions necessary.

2808.translation: Respect consumers choices, but make company responsibility clear too.

2809.translation: Some people insist say all school classes should move online. True, online class fit reduce limits of time and place. But only screen classes no easily give experience of discussing and working together with friends. So online class should support physical class instead of replacing am.

2810.translation: As AI translation tools spread, more people dey think say foreign-language study no necessary again. But tools often miss subtle intention inside context or tone. To judge whether translation correct, user still need understand the language. In short, translator na tool wey support language learning, no be replacement.

2811.translation: People often say competition dey drive progress. True, competition fit bring effort out. But when e too much, people hide information even where cooperation necessary, so total performance fit fall instead. Then issue no be only whether competition dey; na its amount and form. Wetin we should ask no be whether to remove all competition, but which kind we should design.

2812.translation: A: I support expanding work from home. E reduce travel time and improve workers quality of life. B: I accept that benefit. But the survey wey you use as evidence cover only office workers. We no fit easily apply the same conclusion to jobs wey need physical presence. A: True. Na why I propose different scope for each job group.

2813.translation: Some people worry say learning English early dey disturb mother-tongue development. But that worry assume say foreign language reduce the pikin chances to use mother tongue. In reality, plenty studies show say for children wey use mother tongue enough for house, foreign-language exposure no harm native-language ability. Main issue no be only starting foreign language early, but keeping mother-tongue environment strong. If assumption change, conclusion must change too.

2814.translation: This report judge say citizen-participation budgeting improve financial transparency. But its only evidence na satisfaction survey of participating citizens. High satisfaction no necessarily mean finances more transparent. If dem add objective indicators, like budget-spending disclosure or audit findings, conclusion go more trustworthy. In the end, report conclusion don pass wetin its evidence fit support.

2815.translation: Some argue say banning plastic straws go make little difference because straws na small part of plastic waste. If na figures alone, that no wrong. But reading regulation purpose as only reducing waste quantity too narrow. Regulation also fit be symbolic starting point to question habits wey take disposable items for granted. So judgment should consider awareness change as well as quantity.

2816.translation: For meeting, chair say this matter worth reviewing. But immediately after, chair add say budget planning don finish, so decision within this year go hard. Committee members understand say introduction this year no really possible. Even though positive judgment come first, the condition after am show the real direction. One member say words soft, but meaning clear.

2817.translation: Worry say technology dey remove jobs no new. The same fear dey when power loom first come. History show say technology remove some jobs but create new ones too. Still, e too early to relax. Old transitions take decades, but current change much faster. If people no get enough time to adjust, new jobs existing alone no fit remove individual worry.

2818.translation: Experts often compare city traffic to blocked blood vessels. Repeatedly widening blocked vessels through surgery no solve root health problem; lifestyle need change too. Likewise, policy wey spend only on widening roads reduce traffic only temporarily, before vehicles increase again. This comparison dey call for public transport and city structure to change together.

2819.translation: If this hypothesis correct, clear difference should appear between experiment group and comparison group.

2820.translation: Formal written argument use fixed connecting and contrasting expressions. Their endings need match the clauses wey dem join.

2821.translation: In other words, this system purpose na to increase fairness.

2822.translation: Even if cost rise, at least dem no fit lower safety standard.

2823.translation: The debate issue na how far individual responsibility fit go.

2824.translation: Written reports use -ㅁ/-기 endings to turn clauses into noun phrases, then attach subject, object or agent particles.

2825.translation: This interpretation valid for some parts, but e hard to claim say e fit every case.

2826.translation: Academic writing dey soften claims with patterns like could, may and e hard to claim, instead of showing complete certainty.

2827.translation: The debater accept say system necessary, but disagree about when to introduce am.

2828.translation: If we join all the evidence, we fit say problem get complex causes instead of one cause.

2829.translation: At first, opposition plenty, but support gradually grow through briefing sessions.

2830.translation: Even though system advantages clear, dem must no ignore side effects of implementation.

2831.translation: Demand fall sharply, and because of that companies begin adjust output.

2832.translation: Connectors like 이에 따라 and 결과적으로 dey join result to the cause just mentioned. So the earlier clause must give that cause.

2833.translation: Supporters stress job creation, but opponents worry about environmental harm.

2834.translation: Because sample too small, dem rate study reliability low as result.

2835.translation: For debate, first confirm opponent claim evidence accurately before you argue against am.

2836.translation: Even if grounds enough, e no automatically mean conclusion correct.

2837.translation: Biggest benefit of work from home na reduced travel time. Person fit use former travel time rest or develop skills. But e hard to deny say cooperation fit become difficult. So instead of one method for every job, e better to flexibly mix office and remote work according to work type.

2838.translation: One survey show lower average grades for students wey skip breakfast. People use am argue say breakfast must become compulsory. But plenty of those students no get enough sleep because dem attend lesson centres till late. To separate effects, dem need comparison wey keep sleep time equal. Survey cover two hundred students for three middle schools.

2839.translation: City dey consider closing public swimming pool. Main reason na operating cost per user wey be twice nearby private facility own. But that figure include free use by older people and children. E also leave out medical costs wey better health fit reduce. Nobody publish who set comparison rules or how. City plan final policy as early as next month. Users group don start collecting signatures against closure.

2840.translation: Argument for fully allowing remote medical care strong especially where hospitals few. But warning about first-visit misdiagnosis without physical examination matter too. Main issue fit no be simple allow or ban, but which care dem should allow under which conditions. Dem plan discuss this matter as main agenda for medical-system improvement forum within this year.

2841.translation: People often compare history to mirror. But mirror only reflect wetin stand for front; e no choose wetin to show or hide. Before person tell history, dem choose wetin to record and leave out. Same event fit become different scene depending on who write and when. Choosing and arranging sources na already beginning of interpretation. Mirror comparison miss the hand of person wey dey direct reflection.

2842.translation: Plenty studies show say tighter speed limits reduce traffic deaths. But most study areas also get enforcement cameras. Dem never verify whether places without enforcement go get same result. Na why people worry say law wey only change limit number fit no work as expected. Areas with different road conditions don raise this question repeatedly. Discussion of related bill don stall.

2843.translation: A: Report say average sleep time increase after one country ban teenagers late-night game access by law. B: Report follow only one year after rule, cover students for only one city, and another survey show more people bypassing rule. A: Bypassing no make rule useless. Even if some bypass, connection time don reduce. B: I no say e useless. I say make we more careful about claiming how big the effect be.

2844.translation: Company advertise say average staff salary among industry highest. But average include pay for three executives. Company also plan to halve new recruitment this year from last year. Union claim say if dem remove executives and calculate median, figure no even reach industry average. But company no disclose average calculation method, and union no show data source for its calculation either. Dem post promotional phrase for internal noticeboard too.

2845.translation: This result alone no enough to reach firm conclusion about policy effect.

2846.translation: Tentative endings like -(으)ㄹ 것으로 보이다 and -기 어렵다 keep formal written claim cautious instead of stating am as certain.

2847.translation: Before deciding whether to introduce system, dem need first examine expected side effects.

2848.translation: Noun phrases wey use -(으)ㄴ/는 + noun, -다는/-리라는 + noun or -에 대한 + noun compress whole clause so e fit act as subject for formal sentence.

2849.translation: If this interpretation valid, e be like say dem go need revise the existing theory.
